lma.cfg.title: LittleMaidMoreAction Settings
lma.cfg.chain.max_blocks.tip: Maximum blocks broken per chain action (tree felling / mining)
lma.cfg.chain.wood_nature.tip: Prevents maids from breaking player-built wooden structures
lma.cfg.chain.max_distance.tip: Distance limit for chain BFS search and vein breaking
lma.cfg.chain.dig_down_depth.tip: When an exposed ore within this depth overhead is unreachable, dig up through the whole column below it (default 6)
lma.cfg.chain.nav_timeout.tip: Skip and retry if pathfinding exceeds this time; 240 = 12 s (default 240)
lma.cfg.env.enabled.tip: false = maids receive no environment signals (v63)
lma.cfg.env.self_rescue.tip: Triggers a self-rescue task when hurt; instantly breaks suffocating blocks when buried or stuck
lma.cfg.env.radius.tip: Default scan radius when no work area is set
lma.cfg.env.player_gate_radius.tip: Only maids within this range of the player sense the environment; 0 = disabled
lma.cfg.env.darkness.tip: Triggers env_darkness below this light level (mob spawning light level is 7)
lma.cfg.env.structure_enabled.tip: Village / mineshaft / outpost detection (findNearestMapStructure is slow)
lma.cfg.env.structure_signal_radius.tip: Only owner maids within this range of the player receive structure signals
lma.cfg.env.structure_whitelist.tip: Only listed structures emit signals (registry IDs; wildcards like minecraft:village_*; empty = all)
lma.cfg.env.structure_nearest_only.tip: On = only the nearest whitelisted structure emits a signal
lma.cfg.env.structure_random_maid.tip: On = pick one random owner maid nearby; off = pick the nearest
lma.cfg.env.structure_enter.tip: Owner within this distance of the structure center counts as inside (enter signal, no bubble)
lma.cfg.env.structure_leave.tip: Owner beyond this distance counts as leaving (leave signal, no bubble)
lma.cfg.env.structure_refresh_ticks.tip: While outside the structure, resend the direction bubble at this interval (default 2400 = 2 min)
lma.cfg.env.structure_refresh_max.tip: Total reminders per approach (including the first discovery)
lma.cfg.env.rare_biome.tip: Alerts for rare biomes such as mushroom fields, deep dark and lush caves (master switch)
lma.cfg.env.rare_biome_radius.tip: Only owner maids within this range of the player receive rare biome signals
lma.cfg.bi.mark_item.tip: Item used to mark targets by right-clicking blocks (item ID, e.g. minecraft:stick)
lma.cfg.bi.bind_item.tip: Item used to bind tasks by right-clicking a maid (item ID)
lma.cfg.bi.interact_distance.tip: Maximum distance for maid right-click interaction
lma.cfg.bi.trigger_range.tip: Radius scanned for maids around the player when a key trigger fires
lma.cfg.favor.enabled.tip: Efficiency (higher level = faster work) + cost (higher level = lower cost)
lma.cfg.favor.auto_repair.tip: Maids slowly repair gear using XP over time (1 point per ~5 s; cost = 4 XP x favorability cost multiplier)
lma.cfg.favor.cost.tip: Cost = baseline x multiplier (lower is cheaper)
lma.cfg.tower.damage.tip: Global default tower damage (per-tower GUI can override; 2.0 = 1 heart)
lma.cfg.tower.radius.tip: Global default tower targeting radius (per-tower GUI can override)
lma.cfg.misc.power_belt_stress.tip: Custom stress capacity for the running power belt: -1 = use the default formula (1024/2048/4096 depending on cakes); >=0 = fixed value (RPM still follows cakes: 96/192/256)
lma.task.craft.default_product.tip: Item used as the crafting product when there is no target (item ID, e.g. minecraft:golden_apple)
lma.task.craft.max_products.tip: -1 = unlimited; the maid stops once the total is reached (per-maid override in TLM task settings)
lma.task.furnace.blacklist.tip: Items the maid will not smelt (item ID list; modid:* supported)
lma.task.furnace.whitelist.tip: When non-empty, only items in this list are smelted; per-maid list is in TLM task settings
lma.task.jukebox.wait_ticks.tip: 6000 = 5 minutes; the disc is swapped after playback finishes
lma.task.jukebox.blacklist.tip: Disc IDs the maid will not play
lma.task.jukebox.whitelist.tip: When non-empty, only discs in this list are played
lma.task.arm.blacklist.tip: Item IDs the maid will not carry
lma.task.arm.whitelist.tip: When non-empty, only items in this list are carried
lma.task.collect.blacklist.tip: Block IDs the maid will not chop or mine
lma.task.collect.whitelist.tip: When non-empty, only blocks in this list are chopped or mined
lma.task.bell.interval.tip: Minimum interval between rings; 30 = 1.5 s; per-maid override in the TLM task settings tab (v67.13)
lma.task.block_interact.hint: Global settings are in the main screen's 'Right-Click Interaction' category: mark/bind items, interaction distance, trigger range, default timer interval
lma.task.ai.llm.tip: Model entry name created in the Numen G panel; empty = unbound; per-maid override in the TLM task settings tab (v74)
lma.task.ai.voice.tip: Voice entry name created in the Numen G panel; empty = unbound; per-maid override in the TLM task settings tab (v74)
lma.task.ai.chat_bubble.tip: Dummy shows a random emoji-style bubble on a timer (TLM emotes must be enabled)
lma.task.ai.random_voice.tip: Dummy randomly plays maid voice-pack audio (maid must have a voice pack selected in TLM config)
lma.task.haqi.enabled.tip: Off by default; when on, triggering has a chance when the maid approaches other maids
lma.task.haqi.chance.tip: Chance when another maid is within 2 blocks; default 0.1 = 10%
lma.task.haqi.duration.tip: 60 = 3 s; total look duration = base + actual audio length
lma.task.haqi.hit_chance.tip: Chance to swipe the target once during LOOK; default 0.3 = 30%
lma.task.haqi.hit_damage.tip: Swipe damage; default 1.0 = one heart point
lma.task.haqi.owner_enabled.tip: Off by default; requires the Haqi master switch; controls Haqi at the owner only
lma.task.haqi.owner_chance.tip: Chance toward the owner within 2 blocks when no other maid is nearby; default 0.1
lma.task.haqi.owner_hit_chance.tip: Chance to pat the owner once during LOOK; default 0.3
lma.task.haqi.owner_hit_damage.tip: Swipe damage; default 1.0; the owner does not retaliate
lma.task.void.chunks.tip: Digs out an N x N chunk area centered on the origin (from bedrock up to world height); per-maid chunk count can be overridden in TLM task settings
lma.task.void.destroy_list.tip: Items in this list are destroyed as soon as they are mined (not picked up, not dropped); others go to the inventory then the output chest; stops when the inventory is full
lma.task.void.no_pathfind.tip: When on, skip BFS pathfinding and teleport to the chunk center to mine (avoids pathfinding lag)
lma.task.dam_fill.chunks.tip: N x N chunk area centered on the origin (default 1 = single chunk); per-maid override in the TLM task settings page
lma.task.jiuhu.auto_feed.tip: Automatically feeds milk when the owner is hurt (below 70% health) (clears debuffs + applies buffs)
lma.task.jiuhu.toggle.tip: Right-click a maid with an empty bucket to milk
lma.task.jiuhu.wild_extra.tip: On = untamed maids give Wild Kitsune Milk; off = untamed maids also give Kitsune Milk buckets
lma.task.none: This task has no custom settings
message.lma.mark.interact_done: §aInteraction block marked: %s §7(right-click a maid with the block_interact task to bind)
message.lma.mark.stick_required: §cRight-click an interaction block (button / lever / door, etc.) with a stick first
message.lma.bind.interact_done: §aMaid bound to interaction block: %s §7(trigger manually with the key)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.quest.title: LMA Advancement Tree

msg.littlemaidmoreaction.arm.need_seed_h: §cRight-click a container menu with a stick to mark the seed source / harvest target
msg.littlemaidmoreaction.arm.need_take: §cMark the take point: right-click a container menu with a stick
msg.littlemaidmoreaction.mark.need_tool: §cHold a marking item in your main hand (stick by default)
msg.littlemaidmoreaction.void.need_start: §cRight-click a block with a stick to mark the start point
Model entry name created in the Numen panel (G key); empty = global
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.ai.save.tip: Write into this maid’s AI config (per-maid override)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.ai.transform: The maid takes a slate and becomes an AI-controlled fake player (inherits model/health)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.ai.voice.tip: Voice entry name in the Numen panel; empty = global
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.bi.clear.tip: Forget the bound block position (must be marked again)
Interval in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second); 0/empty = global default
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.bi.timer.tip: Right-click the bound block on a fixed interval; off = only on signals
Write the target into this maid’s config
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.craft.target: Item id to craft (e.g. minecraft:stick); empty = target given at submit
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.dam_fill.sav: Store the area size for this maid (per-maid override; max 256)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.dam_fill.siz: N×N chunks centered on the start point; empty = global dam_fill.default_chunks
No regions — select area + mark boxes, right-click maid
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.item_list.ap: Write both fields into this maid’s task config (per-maid override)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.item_list.bl: Matches are denied (takes priority over whitelist); comma-separated ids, modid:* supported; empty = use global
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.item_list.cl: Clear both lists and apply (= fall back to global)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.item_list.wh: If non-empty, only listed items are allowed; empty = no restriction
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.passive.tip: Enable/disable this passive task for this maid (off by default)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.void.destroy: Listed blocks are destroyed without drops
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.void.min_y.t: Stop at this layer; empty = auto-detect bedrock
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.void.nav.tip: Navigation off = teleport to the chunk center and dig (fast, crude); on = normal pathing
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.void.save_li: Save destroy list (comma-separated ids; empty = clear and use global)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.void.save_mi: Save the minimum Y (empty = auto-detect bedrock; set = stop at that layer)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.void.save_si: Store the area size for this maid (per-maid override; max 256; empty = global)
screen.littlemaidmoreaction.void.size.ti: N×N chunks centered on the start point; empty = global void_excavation.default_chunks
